notes:
- Feature: update check. Every 2 minutes the extension reads a small public file (github.com/mharisjamal/qx-signal-trader-releases, latest.json) and, when a newer version exists, shows a banner at the top of the panel with the download link and a Log line. Loaded-unpacked extensions cannot update themselves; this makes the update a one-click download plus reload.
- Tooling: `bash tools/release.sh` builds, tags, pushes and publishes the release on both the private source repo and the public downloads repo.
